values.meaning: Duration of the infection before it bursts into damage
values.quote: infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.

values.meaning: Increased damage taken by infected targets, from all sources, for the infection's duration
values.quote: infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.

mechanics.claim: Hemoplague's cast applies a 4-second infection to enemies hit that increases the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
mechanics.quote: infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.

mechanics.claim: When the 4-second infection ends, it bursts to deal its magic damage to all affected targets immediately; the resulting heal for each infected champion follows a further 0.4-second delay.
mechanics.quote: the infection bursts to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all affected targets and, after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay, {{tip|heal}} '''Vladimir''' for each infected champion

mechanics.claim: Hemoplague amplifies its own burst damage with its 10% damage-taken debuff, for an actual damage of base x1.1 (+77% AP) rather than the base x1.0 (+70% AP) figure.
mechanics.quote: ''Hemoplague'' amplifies itself for an actual damage of {{ap|150*1.1 to 350*1.1}} {{as|(+ {{fd|77}}% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: Hemoplague's damage-taken amplification stacks multiplicatively with other damage modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Hemoplague's'' effect {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other damage modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Hemoplague amplifies almost all sources and types of damage, including damage from neutral monsters.
mechanics.quote: ''Hemoplague'' will amplify almost all sources and types of damage, even including damage from neutral monsters.

mechanics.claim: True damage is not amplified by Hemoplague (documented as a bug).
mechanics.quote: {{as|{{sti|True damage}}}} will however not be amplified.{{bug}}
